summary: Completed end-to-end testing of Golden Palm City — Concierge real-estate experience. 11/11 backend pytest tests passed (health, projects list, projects-by-slug for all 4 slugs, invalid slug 404, concierge create+list, minimal payload, validation 422s). 10/10 frontend Playwright flows passed (hero copy, hero/header/float WhatsApp links, scroll-triggered floating CTA, all 5 nav links scroll into view, 4 project cards from API with flagship full-width, form validation toast, form submit creates backend inquiry + opens WhatsApp deep link, mobile hamburger menu).
critical_code_review_comments: review_request listed slug 'golden-sanctuary' for the flagship project, but backend & frontend use slug 'golden-palm-city' (the host 'golden-sanctuary.preview.emergentagent.com' may have caused the confusion). Tests adapted accordingly; no code bug.

/api/concierge/inquiries GET is a public unauthenticated endpoint that lists all lead submissions including names/phones/emails — consider protecting this endpoint behind admin auth before going live; it currently leaks PII.
CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — combination is invalid per CORS spec; restrict origins in production.
ConciergeInquiry stores created_at as ISO string in Mongo but the GET handler re-parses it — fine for now, but storing native BSON datetime is cleaner.
test_credentials: Not required — app is fully public, no auth.
seed_data_creation: Created two TEST_ prefixed concierge inquiries via pytest (TEST_Concierge User, TEST_Minimal) and one via Playwright (TEST_Playwright User). They are stored in MongoDB collection concierge_inquiries.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_api.py; run with `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> python -m pytest backend/tests/test_api.py -v`. The real flagship slug is 'golden-palm-city' (not 'golden-sanctuary' as the original prompt suggested). Frontend uses lenis/react smooth scroll — section assertions must allow ~700ms after click. WhatsApp form submit calls window.open which can be safely stubbed in headless tests via `window.open = (u) => { window.__opened = u; }`.
rca of the issue: No bugs identified. All requested flows function end-to-end.
